description: Pulse — public, anonymous, rate-limited event channels (the Shared Storm substrate). An explicitly-configured channel accepts tiny schema-validated events from anyone (CORS-open on its own routes only), keeps a durable total-ever counter, and serves a cursor-based recent feed cheap enough for every open browser tab to poll. Events are ephemeral (TTL-swept); the counter is forever. Lightning strikes today; guestbooks, reactions, live presence tomorrow.
